coverage.denominator: Added/modified executable Swift lines in Sources/Typeflux, including new files, intersected with final LLVM LCOV DA records. Tests, helper wrapper and unchanged vendor code excluded; helper reported separately.

project_wide_focused_line_coverage.note: This is the project-wide report from a focused run, not full-project test execution.

native_cpp_helper.note: C++ helper unchanged; Swift filesystem worker coverage belongs to the app.

benchmark.quantiles: nearest rank, 2ms visibility polling; all 30 samples retained
benchmark.concurrency: one index writer, no interactive queries, no backlog; one small file/one chunk per arrival
benchmark.cache: New indexing/file worker instances per reconciliation; OS page cache not controlled. First arrival reported separately; no reused warm-model process claim.
benchmark.measurement: file write/FSEvent to committed FTS or complete vectors; not query latency or UI rendering

verified-coverage.json.definition: ps resident pages, bytes; descendant validation processes only. Shared pages are double counted in sums. Compiler/build processes excluded.

verified-test-rss.json.definition: ps RSS bytes; final same-binary test host and descendants. Window begins after runner startup and ends on host exit; sampled peaks, not full-run high-water marks. Shared pages double counted in sums; build processes excluded.

optional_branches_not_activated: SemanticFileServiceTests/actual model checksum and atomic install when provided
SemanticRealtimeSearchTests/real file change indexes and publishes with real model when provided (both arguments)
